proof_body:
by
  intro θ n
  have hE : ∀ t : ℝ, (Real.cos t : ℂ) + (Real.sin t : ℂ) * Complex.I = Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro t
    rw [Complex.exp_mul_I]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [hE, hE, ← Complex.exp_int_mul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring
target_source: ∀ (θ : ℝ) (n : ℤ), ((Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n = (Real.cos (n * θ) : ℂ) + (Real.sin (n * θ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
